title: Palestine: A Living Map - stories file
description: Shape of public/data/stories.json. Mirrors src/data/storyTypes.ts. Extra checks (event ids exist, caption length, unique ids) live in scripts/validate-data.ts.

placeholder.description: True for sample stories that must be replaced before launch.

showLakes.description: Show the 1946 lake outlines while this story runs.

showControl.description: Show the control-of-the-land zones while this story runs.

showSettlements.description: Show the Israeli settlements on the map while this story runs.

caption.description: Max 40 words; checked by the validator.

cameraZoom.description: Map zoom for this step; omit to use the default for the event's location precision.
